newsitem.title: USA: Technical Chemicals joint venture dissolved.
newsitem.headline: Technical Chemicals joint venture dissolved.

text.p: Technical Chemicals & Products Inc and Genetronics Biomedical Ltd's said they have mutually agreed to dissolve PharmaTronics LLC, a 50/50 joint venture formed in 1995.

Jack Aronowitz, Technical Chemicals chief executive and president, said, "This joint venture is not related in any way to the company's non-invasive TD Glucose Monitoring System or our other transdermal drug delivery products in development."

"The technology being explored under this joint venture was entered into by a predecessor and does not fit TCPI's expansion plans for its current portfolio of diagnostic and transdermal drug delivery products in various stages of marketing, development and governmental approvals," Aronowitz said.
